questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the present simple tense?
options: She always go to work by bus.
He don’t like tea; he prefers coffee.
They are living in London since 2019.
We go shopping every Saturday.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct with the past simple tense?
options: Yesterday, I was playing football in the park.
Last week, she go to the cinema with her friends.
In 2018, they lived in Manchester.
Tomorrow, I will visit my grandmother.

questions.question: Which word correctly completes the sentence: 'I have ______ a new car for my birthday.'?
options: buy
buying
bought
buys

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'the' correctly?
options: I saw a dog yesterday. It was very big.
The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
She has an apple and an orange in her bag.
We visited the beach last summer.
questions.answer: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

questions.question: Which preposition fits best in this sentence: 'She is interested ______ painting.'?
options: in
at
for
with

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'his' correctly?
options: Her car is red.
His bike is broken.
Our house is very big.
Their children are playing outside.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a pronoun?
options: She go to the store every day.
They have visited us last month.
He don’t like eating vegetables.
We are going to the park tomorrow.
questions.answer: They have visited us last month.

questions.question: Which word correctly completes the sentence: 'The teacher said, “Don’t ______ your homework!”'?
options: forget
forgetting
forgot
forgets

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses 'a' or 'an'?
options: She has a cat and an orange.
I saw a plane flying in the sky.
He has an apple and a banana.
They are going to buy a house next year.
questions.answer: She has a cat and an orange.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses 'was' or 'were'?
options: She was happy when she saw her friend.
They was playing outside when it started raining.
We were eating dinner when the phone rang.
He was go to the market yesterday.
questions.answer: She was happy when she saw her friend.
